answer: Each identity is bound to one device key, and that device co-signs every submission. Enrolling a second identity on the same hardware needs a seven-day cooling period plus two existing members as witnesses, so a farm must acquire real machines instead of minting keys. A hollow clone that copies a device key voids both identities, and the violet flag on that hardware blocks re-enrolment for a year. An honest agent changing phones waits once; a haven of farms loses its whole fleet at the first duplicate signature.
